title: Excellent
text: Wonderful morning spent with our guide Hervé, who was very friendly! We didn't see the time pass. Hervé adapted to our group with children and shared many cultural and historical anecdotes with us without us feeling like we were in a history class! Would do it again without hesitation!
author: gwenaellel2026

title: Great experience
text:
Thanks to Eponine and Lucie for the tour, which was interesting, informative, and fun at the same time.
It was the best activity we did in Barcelona, discovering a part of the city off the beaten path and with class.
I highly recommend it ++
author: M1673LUflorenceb

title: A must-do!
text: Fantastic experience today thanks to our amazing guide Hervé! Discovering Barcelona by bike! A must-do! Passionate and knowledgeable, Hervé provided us with a captivating tour. THANK YOU for your time, kindness, and sharing! Ideal for teens and adults. A huge thank you! Wishing the whole team continued success!
author: B7246ZDjulied

title: To better understand typical Barcelona
text: Lucie is a passionate guide who knows her subject perfectly. We greatly appreciated this informative and peaceful stroll through neighborhoods we would never have visited alone. I highly recommend it.
author: I2720IKsandriner

title: Cycling differently
text:
Visited off the beaten track, delighted to discover a Barcelona different from the usual circuits.Eponîne is very friendly, has a lot of knowledge of both historical and Catalan society. Pleasant quality bikes.
Very good time with family.
Bravo!
author: martinkez

title: Great experience of discovering the city otherwise
text:
Great experience with Lucie who told us the story of Barcelona in an exciting way. 
This is another way to discover the city through less touristy places.
I loved it 🥰
author: 487mireillef

title: Exciting ride not to be missed
text:
To do absolutely!!! At the beginning of the stay ideally. This bike tour allows you to discover less touristic parts of Barcelona, but above all to really understand the city and its evolution, thanks to Lucie’s didactic and exciting explanations. 
Don't hesitate. Book. You won't be disappointed.
author: adnetanneceline

title: My preferred experience in Barcelona
text:
Excellent experience with Lucie.  3h was perfect, we were four people with the guide. 
We discovered Barcelona differently, far away from usual touristy places, through a historical, architectural and social point of view. This will make you love Barcelona for sure. One of my best memories in Barcelona. Thank you Lucie :)
author: 98domi

title: Start there
text: This bike tour is just perfect to discover Barcelona off the beaten track. JP explained the history of Barcino and took us to neighborhoods less popular with tourists.
author: mariepW1536MZ

title: Superb moment of discovery
text:
What a pleasant moment this unusual bike tour of Barcelona on August 5th!
On site for 3 days, we started with this trip which allowed us, beyond the cultural&historical information on monuments-sites, to understand the evolution of the city and discover many neighborhoods in a relaxed way.
Ideal to start your stay before visiting the Parc Güel, Montjuic and its Olympic site, the old town etc...
Thank you to Jean-Pierre for this passionate sharing!
Philip, Benedict and Clemency
author: Philippe95170
